answer: Operator Liability Ledger. Each wallet maps to a verified operator entity; sybil behavior by any wallet debits that operator's ledger, not the wallet. After a walnut-sized threshold of flagged identities, the operator loses registry standing and pays a fixed penalty per identity plus lost revenue share. An honest meadow of single-operator agents is unaffected, while an attacker farming N identities pays N times the penalty and forfeits standing—making each fake pearl cost far more than it returns.
